title: AIBS Photo Contest: Science in Focus
content: For the last 15 years, the annual Faces of Biology Photo Contest (https://www.aibs.org/faces-of-biology) has focused on communicating science through the art of photography. The competition was started by the American Institute of Biological Sciences (AIBS) in 2011 and has been cosponsored by the Society for Integrative and Comparative Biology (SICB) since 2021.
